home_prompt: Create an elegant Japanese website homepage design concept for 千葉陶芸工房, pottery classes and experience studio in Chiba Japan. Wide exact16:9 flat screenshot no device/browser. Editorial warm off-white, muted clay terracotta, charcoal, faint hand drawn leaf line motifs; clean restrained Japanese typography and large whitespace, high quality photography. Brand 千葉陶芸工房 plain text at upper left, nav 陶芸体験 / コースのご案内 / 出張工房 / お問い合わせ; right small phone 043-301-4606. Hero left clear large headline 土にふれて、器をつくる。 subtitle 電動ロクロ・てびねりの陶芸体験. Two buttons コースを見る and お問い合わせ. Right original editorial closeup photo of hands shaping clay bowl on pottery wheel; no real staff identity. Bottom clear two or three calm photo cards 電動ロクロ / てびねり / 工房へのアクセス. Include broad clean inquiry callout ご質問・ご相談はこちら with 問い合わせる. Concept is to lead to existing inquiry form that will fit mobile width with stacked labels/fields. Do not invent booking/calendar/dates, prices, duration, reviews, ranking, guarantees, availability, staff biographies, hours or claim all courses available. Do not mention color painting class available. Do not copy existing logo/photo. Small clear label 非公式の改善イメージ.
inquiry_prompt: Make matching SECOND PAGE web design screenshot for 千葉陶芸工房 from reference homepage; same off-white, clay terracotta, charcoal, faint leaf motifs. Wide16:9 flat screenshot, no device/browser frame. Prominent complete inquiry form design with ALL labels above their fields in a single vertical column, no horizontal overflow. Use a narrow form column about 550px centered/right on the wide canvas with spacious neutral background, left brief title お問い合わせ and small note ご質問・ご相談などをお受けしています plus a small photo of handmade pottery. Main header identical brand 千葉陶芸工房 and restrained nav. Keep existing fields exactly, do NOT add required markers or fields: お名前, メールアドレス, メールアドレス（再度入力）, 問合せ種別 with 5 unselected radio choices ご質問 ご相談 ご予約 ご依頼 その他 wrapping within column, 問合せ内容 with multiline blank textarea. Then terracotta button 送信する and secondary リセット. Keep below them compact existing privacy text: 個人情報の取扱いについて / ご記入いただいた個人情報は、お問い合わせへの対応および確認のためのみに利用します。 / この目的のためにお問い合わせの記録を残すことがあります。 Fit full form visibly, fields unfilled, all right borders visible. No checkboxes/consent additions, no confirmation step, no booking calendar, pricing, hours, availability or completion message. Small footer 非公式の改善イメージ. Balanced professional Japanese UI, preserve text legibility, form takes priority over decoration. This is responsive stacked layout improvement concept.
